g.aria-label: PRODUCTION HANDOFF
From concept to installation
Portable artwork is included. Final sign engineering and print setup are not.
Select the application
Over the door: entrance panel or compact signature.
Long outside wall: single-line fascia.
Above the pulpit: one-colour symbol or sanctuary version.
Pulpit face: symbol only; no small lettering.
Roadside: portrait panel; name before details.
Keep the identity consistent
Never mirror or rotate the street junction.
The church always stays north-west.
Keep one road-stem width of clear space.
Use one colour for engraving or cut vinyl.
Do not add arrows to the mark itself.
Ask the sign professional
Measure the wall, doorway and viewing distances.
Confirm approvals and any heritage restrictions.
Choose material, thickness, fixings and lighting.
Check wind loading and building attachment.
The two separate shapes need a fixing strategy.
Files and reproduction
SVG and PDF: vector paths, including lettering.
Editable SVG: live Segoe UI text; font not supplied.
PNG: transparent where no background is specified.
RGB colours: printer must convert and proof.
No physical dimensions, bleed or PDF-X claim.
Design size recommendations
Detailed symbol: begin at 64px / 16mm.
Horizontal: 360px / 85mm. Compact: 260px / 65mm.
Stacked: 240px / 60mm. Fascia: 600px / 150mm.
Micro mark: 16-48px, solid gable silhouette.
Proof at actual size; these are starting points.
Release boundary
This is a conceptual identity for church review.
Scenes are schematic, not the actual building.
No public site or permanent signage was changed.
Confirm church approval and trademark clearance.
Obtain final supplier proofs before production.
Grafton Baptist Church / Corner Cross / 18 October 2026
